payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs compared to preserved fossil reef facies, indicating a preservation bias and erosion effects.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs despite the presence of preserved fossil MIS 5e reef facies at Lembetabe.
The preservation bias in the representation of MIS 5e sequences is due to erosion and sediment transport processes.
Isolated pockets of preserved reef material suggest that the lack of exposed facies may be due to short-term environmental changes or broader sea level events.
